test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** "razing".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Razing -** To completely destroy something so nothing is left.
 
• **Example -** *The building was razed by the government.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Racing - **It is the sport of taking part in races.

 
 
• **Example -** *He always participates in motor racing.*
 
 
 
• **Raising - **To increase the level of something.
 
 
• **Example - ***The government is going to raise taxes.*
 
 
 
• **Rising -** growing or advancing to adult years.
 
 
• **Example - ***Nowadays, living cost is rising.*
